name: PhotoPrism-Helper
description: PhotoPrism Helper is an unofficial companion tool created for use alongside PhotoPrism. This project isn't associated with the PhotoPrism project, it's just a companion tool created to extend the functionality of PhotoPrism.

ports.name: Host Port
ports.description: The port the helper is hosted on. Container Port: 2343

variables.name: PhotoPrism Site URL
variables.description: Container Variable: PHOTOPRISM_SITE_URL

variables.name: PhotoPrism Username
variables.description: The PhotoPrism username you want the helper to use for access.

variables.name: PhotoPrism Password
variables.description: The PhotoPrism password associated with the username.

variables.name: Helper API Key
variables.description: The API key you'll use to query the helper API.

variables.name: Timezone
variables.description: The timezone of your instance.

variables.name: Import Timeout
variables.description: The number of milliseconds the import function should wait for a success message before timing out.

variables.name: Auto Import
variables.description: Enable/Disable the auto-import feature.

variables.name: Auto Import Cron Schedule
variables.description: The cron expression for when to run auto-import.

variables.name: Index After Auto Import
variables.description: Enable/Disable the index after auto-importing feature.

variables.name: Auto Index
variables.description: Enable/Disable the auto-index feature.

variables.name: Auto Index Cron Schedule
variables.description: The cron expression for when to run auto-index.

variables.name: ISDOCKER
variables.description: Tells the helper instance if it is running in a Docker container. Container Variable: ISDOCKER

variables.name: Logfile Path
variables.description: The logging file path.

variables.name: Log Level - Console
variables.description: The log level to apply to the console log.

variables.name: Log Level - File
variables.description: The log level to apply to the file log.

variables.name: Send Errors to the Developer
variables.description: Enable/Disable sending errors/exceptions to the dev.

variables.name: Error Log URL (Dev)
variables.description: The URL to send errors to. (Don't change unless you're running your own fork of the helper)

variables.name: Error Log Key (Dev)
variables.description: The API key sent with error logs to the external server.

variables.name: Anonymise Error Logs
variables.description: Enable/Disable anonymising externally sent error logs.

variables.name: Send Options in Error Log
variables.description: Enable/Disable sending your configuration options with externally sent errors.

variables.name: Add Logging to External Server
variables.description: Enable/Disable sending logs to an external log server.

variables.name: External Log Depth
variables.description: The log level to apply to the external log.

variables.name: External Log URL
variables.description: The URL of the external log server.

variables.name: External Log API Key
variables.description: The API key sent with logs sent to the external log server.

variables.name: Anonymise External Logs
variables.description: Enable/Disable anonymising externally sent logs.

variables.name: Send Options in External Logs
variables.description: Enable/Disable sending your configuration options with externally sent logs.
